philosophical_additions.representational_defeater: If scientifically motivated source-compatible representations change an overlap verdict used for individuation, reconstruction success under one representation is insufficient by itself until the live alternative is discriminated against.
philosophical_additions.relation_to_discrimination_requirement: The defeater is an inferential corollary of the Discrimination Requirement, not a new ontology or global skepticism.
philosophical_additions.beni_source_pin: Publisher PDF locations for Beni's strongest kind-individuation and PP-FEP-scaffolding claims are recorded exactly.
philosophical_additions.positive_mini_case: Patterson-Nestor-Rogers supplies an illustration of discriminating evidence through a differential lesion prediction and semantic-dementia evidence; it is not treated as a completed cross-source capacity-identity proof.
